llm.summary: This skill is a classroom interaction coaching guide for teachers with disclosed, scoped use of classroom planning and observation records.

dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly scoped to mainland China Chinese K12 teaching contexts and includes localization warnings for other regions; this explains the Chinese-only content rather than hiding a locale constraint.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is markdown/schema content with no executable install script, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, shell commands, or hidden runtime mechanism found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill uses broad Chinese classroom phrases as activation examples, but it also lists adjacent requests to route elsewhere and frames activation as suggested, with teacher-facing output only.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It uses platform memory/workspace data and writes interactionLogs, but the write is limited to aggregate classroom observations, generates teacher-confirmed pending entries, avoids student names in logs, and includes view/correct/delete/pause/export/share controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently focuses on classroom questioning, grouping, timing, cold-call recovery, feedback, and post-class observation; its reads of lesson plans, class profile, student tiers, and weakness summaries are aligned with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this for Chinese-language, mainland China K12 teacher workflows where classroom plans, tier summaries, and aggregate post-class observations may be used. Before use outside that context, localize language, curriculum assumptions, privacy/legal defaults, and emergency-contact guidance; teachers should confirm any record writes and avoid entering real student names in interaction logs.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only language and mainland China K12 defaults are disclosed in shared/platform-conventions.md and crisis guidance; this is a deployment scope note, not hidden behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger examples are broad classroom-coaching phrases, but they match the skill purpose and the artifact provides negative routing examples for lesson planning, exam design, student analysis, and assignments.
[SDI-1] expected: The ai-item-check file is referenced only as a guardrail for rare, oral, temporary examples and explicitly says ordinary question generation should be routed to the exam designer.
[SDI-2] expected: Assessment-item checks are broader than the core classroom-coaching flow, but here they function as safety/quality constraints for incidental examples rather than expanding the skill into an assessment workflow.
